_readme: Promo codes for estimates. Matching ignores letter case. The discount comes off window cost including glass upcharges (laminated, tempered, obscured — each 12%, stacked). It never applies to installation labor, per-window add-ons (2nd story, difficult access, oversized/heavy), or stucco repair & paint. appliesToLabor true is the only way a code also discounts labor, and even then it does not touch add-ons or stucco. percent = that percent off the window total. bogo = one free window per (buy + get) windows, using the cheapest window price including glass. NOBLEBOGO is buy 4 get 1, so one free window per 5 (5–9 windows discounts one, 10–14 discounts two, and so on). A bogo code with fewer windows than buy+get is still valid and discounts $0.
